1.5.0.en: Added Sonos driver for direct Spotify playback via UPnP. Works alongside the existing Spotify Connect driver.

1.0.0.en: First release that adds speaker capabilities which enable a fully working media/speaker widget and it's flows in Homey

1.0.1.en: Renamed the app to distinguish it from the official Spotify app

1.0.2.en: Allows volume to be set between -100 and +100 (used in relative volume card)

1.1.0.en: 4 new flow charts are available to start playback (song, artist, album and playlist)

1.2.0.en: Adds a widget to search Spotify songs, artists, albums and playlists and starts playback on the (to the widget) connected device.

1.2.1.en: Utilizes the existing queue when starting a single song and resumes the queue afterwards

1.3.0.en: Adds currently playback info Flow card

1.3.1.en: Adds add song to queue card

1.3.4.en: Decreased search limit from 20 to 10 to match Spotifys new policy

1.4.0.en: Added search type filter and option to load more results

1.4.1.en: Add search filters and load more option in the widget

1.5.0.en: Fixes: devices no longer go unavailable when idle, play card now wakes inactive devices via Spotify Connect transfer, play/pause/shuffle/repeat/mute no longer flip the wrong way after external state changes, playlist autocomplete now sees your full library (including Daily Mix), and devices auto-recover when Spotify reassigns their ID.

1.6.0.en: Testbranch containing improvements to keep devices available, improve capabilities stability and full playlist fetching
